newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA'S FORMER HANDBALL CAPTAIN TO HEAD STEAUA.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA'S FORMER HANDBALL CAPTAIN TO HEAD STEAUA.

text.p: Cristian Gatu, who captained Romania to the world handball championship in 1970 and 1974, was named on Tuesday to head the country's leading sports club Steaua.
Gatu replaces General Cornel Otelea as "commander of the military club", defence officials said. There were no official reasons for the switch.
The 53-year-old Gatu served as junior sports minister in the early post-communist years.
Bucharest-based Steaua is still subordinated to the army, according to old Soviet-style sports rules dating back to its creation 50 years ago.
